and (cm.content like concat('%', #{content}, '%') or cm.nickname like concat('%', #{content}, '%') or p.post_title like concat('%', #{content}, '%'))

where cm.post_id=#{postId} and cm.status='1' order by cm.create_time asc, cm.comment_id asc
